title: Scarcity breaks when the world is already full
summary: This meets the comparing gaze that keeps turning abundance into rivalry. The line says the One is already pervading every form, while comparison only keeps the cycle turning.
takeaway: See fullness before you compare again.
lifeApplication: When another person's beauty, success, or closeness starts shrinking you, widen the gaze and name three forms already carrying the One. Refuse the tunnel that comparison builds.

source.shortMeaning: Comparison weakens when every form is seen as already filled.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison narrows you, look again for the One already filling the scene.
